iam_replace_managed_policy.summary: Attach the approved least-privilege policy for the agent class, then detach administrator-equivalent managed policies (attach first, so a partial failure never leaves the agent without permissions).

iam_apply_permissions_boundary.summary: Set the approved permissions boundary on the execution role (least disruptive containment).

iam_remove_inline_policy.summary: Delete an inline policy that grants administrator or dangerous actions (its document is saved in the pre-state).

iam_tag_role.summary: Tag the execution role with governance tags.

agentcore_apply_governance_tags.summary: Apply governance tags to the AgentCore runtime: values from the registry, or quarantine tags (aigov:status=noncompliant). Owner values are never invented.

bedrock_apply_governance_tags.summary: Apply governance tags to the Bedrock agent: values from the registry, or quarantine tags (aigov:status=noncompliant). Owner values are never invented.

bedrock_disable_action_group.summary: Set the action group to DISABLED on the DRAFT version (aliases on numbered versions are not affected).

bedrock_pause_agent_alias.summary: Set the alias invocation state to REJECT_INVOCATIONS (the kill switch for a Bedrock Agents Classic agent).
